name: Wiggle Fast
expression: wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider'));
description: Fast wiggle - 10 times per second, 50 pixels.

name: Wiggle Slow
expression: wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider'));
description: Slow wiggle - 2 times per second, 20 pixels.

name: Wiggle 1D (Only Y)
expression:
w = wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider'));
[value[0], w[1]];
description: Wiggles position but only up and down (Y axis).

name: Wiggle 1D (Only X)
expression:
w = wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider'));
[w[0], value[1]];
description: Wiggles position but only left and right (X axis).

name: Loop Out (Cycle)
expression: loopOut('cycle');
description: Loops animation continuously after the last keyframe.

name: Loop Out (Ping-Pong)
expression: loopOut('pingpong');
description: Bounces animation backwards and forwards continuously.

name: Loop Out (Offset)
expression: loopOut('offset');
description: Continues the animation moving forward infinitely.

name: Time Remap (Double Speed)
expression: time * effect('Time Multiplier')('Slider');
description: Plays the composition at 200% speed.

name: Posterize Time (Stop Motion)
expression:
posterizeTime(effect('Framerate')('Slider'));
value;
description: Forces the layer to playback at 12 fps for a stop-motion look.

name: Inertial Bounce (Keyframes)
description: Realistic exponential decay bounce based on keyframe velocity. Excellent for UI.

name: Elastic Scale (Keyframes)
description: Realistic elastic pop-in based on scale keyframe velocity. Excellent for App UI.

name: Elastic Pop-In (InPoint)
description: Automatically scales and bounces a layer precisely when it starts appearing.

name: Cursor Blink
expression:
var spd = effect('Spd')('Slider');
Math.round(time * spd) % 2 === 0 ? 100 : 0;
description: Creates a hard flashing opacity perfectly mimicking a typing text cursor.

name: Typewriter Text
expression:
var rate = effect('Rate')('Slider'); // characters per second
text.sourceText.substr(0, time * rate);
description: Reveals text character by character based on time progression.

name: Counter (Commas & Decimals)
description: Turns a slider into a beautifully formatted SaaS counter (e.g. $1,234.56). Needs Slider.

name: Count Up Timer (00:00)
description: A perfect 00:00 count-up timer starting from the layer inPoint.

name: Count Down Timer (00:00)
description: A perfect 1-minute countdown timer starting from the layer inPoint.

name: Binary Matrix Code
description: Generates a grid of random 0s and 1s that change every frame.

name: Hexadecimal Glitch
description: Generates a rapidly changing string of hacker-style hexadecimal letters.

name: Random Tech Word Cycle
description: Cycles repeatedly through tech buzzwords every half second.

name: Tech Glitch Opacity
description: Randomly flickers opacity based on a chance percentage. Great for broken tech.

name: Tech Glitch Position
description: Violently snaps position around for short, randomized bursts.

name: Glitch XYZ Separate
expression:
seedRandom(index, true);
[wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider'))[0], value[1]];
description: Glitches only the X value rapidly, creating a digital tearing effect.

name: Auto-Scroll (UI Parallax)
expression:
var speed = effect('Speed')('Slider');
[value[0], value[1] + (time * speed)];
description: Endlessly scrolls a layer vertically based on time.

name: Constant Rotation
expression:
var speed = effect('Speed')('Slider');
time * speed;
description: Endlessly rotates a layer at a continuous speed.

name: Continuous Drift
description: Drifts the layer smoothly across the screen diagonally forever.

name: Look At (Target tracking)
description: Rotates current layer to always stare exactly at a layer named 'Target'.

name: Magnetic Proximity Scale
description: Scales up when a layer named 'Cursor' comes close. macOS dock effect.

name: Distance Based Opacity (Fade near)
description: Fades the layer away when the cursor layer approaches.

name: Index Stagger Falloff
description: Delays the animation identically down the layer stack depending on layer index.

name: 3D Flip Stagger (Rotation X)
description: Peels open layers sequentially by flipping them 90 degrees in 3D space.

name: Follow Leader with Delay
description: Endlessly chases the position of the layer immediately above it.

name: Mouse Cursor Follow (Heavy Delay)
expression:
var delay = effect('Delay')('Slider');
thisComp.layer("Cursor").transform.position.valueAtTime(time - delay);
description: Follows a 'Cursor' layer with a sluggish, smoothed delay.

name: Ripple Effect (Index Delay Scale)
description: Pops layers up dynamically in an explosive chain reaction.

name: Circular Orbit
description: Endlessly orbits in a perfect circle using sine and cosine math.

name: Spiral Orbit
description: Spirals aggressively outward from the center point over time.

name: Pendulum Swing
description: Swings back and forth endlessly like a perfectly smooth pendulum.

name: Sine Wave Float
description: Gently floats a layer up and down forever using sine wave mathematics.

name: Float On Water (X & Y)
description: Moves horizontally while bobbing up and down mimicking a boat.

name: Clamp Values to Screen
description: Forces a layer to never be dragged outside a 1920x1080 screen limit.

name: Clamp to Edges (No Bounce)
description: Clamps position coordinates to stay within a 1920x1080 screen limit without true bouncing physics.

name: Color Flash Loop
description: Harshly snaps back and forth between two defined colors.

name: Random Hue Cycle
expression:
posterizeTime(effect('Framerate')('Slider'));
[random(effect("Rand Max")("Slider")), random(effect("Rand Max")("Slider")), random(effect("Rand Max")("Slider")), 1];
description: Chooses a completely random RGB color every 5 frames.

name: Smooth Rainbow Cycle
description: Gently slides through the entire color wheel consistently.

name: Auto-Fade In/Out (15 frames)
description: Automatically dissolves layer in at the start and out at the end.

name: Bounce on Marker (Scale)
description: Triggers an exponential bounce scale every time it hits a layer marker.

name: Wiggle on Marker (Position)
description: Briefly triggers an earthquake wiggle when encountering a marker.

name: Maintain Stroke Width
description: Add to Stroke Width to keep it pixel-perfect even when scaling layer.

name: Camera Shake (Handheld)
description: Layers two independent wiggles for a hyper-realistic organic handheld camera drift.

name: Snap to Grid
description: Forces position to lock onto an invisible 50-pixel grid layout.

name: Heartbeat / Pulse
description: Throbs continuously like a pounding heart.

name: Loading Spinner (Steps)
description: Snaps rotation into a 8-step loading circle playback.

name: Jiggle Scale (Nervous)
expression:
w = wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider'));
[w[0], w[0]];
description: Creates extreme anxiety and shivering through chaotic uniform scale changes.

name: Floating Hologram
expression: Math.abs(Math.sin(time * effect('Time Multiplier')('Slider'))) * 50 + 50;
description: Generates a ghostly pulsing opacity curve perfect for sci-fi UI.

name: Dynamic Text Box (Size)
description: For shape layers. Scales exactly to width/height of a layer named 'Text'.

name: Dynamic Text Box (Position)
description: For shape layers. Positions accurately behind 'Text' respecting descenders.

name: Squash and Stretch (Velocity)
description: Deforms shape based on how fast it moves imitating real physics.

name: Flickering Neon Sign
expression: wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider')) > 50 ? 100 : 20;
description: Brutal broken electrical flickering tube light effect.

name: Data Viz: Bar Chart Height
expression:
s = effect("Slider Control")("Slider");
[value[0], s];
description: Links shape Y-scale specifically to a slider to build bar charts.

name: Text Auto-Kerning / Tracking
description: Breathes character tracking continuously in and out.

name: Random Position Jump
description: Teleports instantly to a random screen coordinate 5 times a second.

name: Velocity Based Rotation
description: Tilts the layer automatically matching the direction it is moving in.

name: 3D Position Extrusion Stagger
expression: [value[0] - index, value[1] - index];
description: Perfect for faked 3D stacks, precisely offsets by 1 pixel diagonally per layout order.

name: Audio Amplitude Scale
description: Breathes to the beat of an Audio Amplitude keyframe layer.

name: Smooth Sine Opacity
description: Throbs gently back and forth between two defined opacities.

name: Rotate to Velocity Vector
description: Aims the layer forward along the exact path it travels.

name: Sine Wave Stroke Dash Offset
expression: time * effect('Time Multiplier')('Slider');
description: Endlessly scrolls a dashed stroke forward.

name: Jittery Rotation
expression:
posterizeTime(effect('Framerate')('Slider'));
wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider'));
description: Stop-motion harsh shaky rotation movement.

name: Wiggle Opacity Only On Marker
description: Only stutters opacity for precisely 1 second after passing a marker.

name: Random Hex Color
description: Randomly changes HEX code string (For text layers).

name: Smooth Dampened Position
description: Lags far behind a target object, useful for smooth camera rigs.

name: Sine Wave Text Jumper
description: Use on a Text Animator position. Makes characters jump in a wave.

name: Blinking Console Line
expression:
var blinkSpeed = effect('Blink Speed')('Slider');
Math.floor(time * blinkSpeed) % 2 == 0 ? "_" : " ";
description: Recreates a blinking terminal underscore _

name: Overshoot Text Animator (Scale)
description: Incredible bouncy overshoot specifically for text animator scale property.

name: Counter with Leading Zeros
description: Formats a number to always have leading zeros (e.g. 0004, 0521).

name: Time To Frames (UI)
expression: timeToFrames(t = time + thisComp.displayStartTime, fps = 1.0 / thisComp.frameDuration, isDuration = false);
description: Displays exactly what frame number the timeline is currently on.

name: Maintain Scale (Ignore Parent)
description: Fixes aspect ratio crushing. Keeps the layer at 100% scale even if its parent is scaled.

name: Maintain Rotation (Ignore Parent)
expression: -parent.transform.rotation;
description: Keeps the layer completely level and upright even if its parent layer rotates.

name: Auto Grid Layout (Position)
description: Instantly arranges layers into a perfect structural grid based on their index.

name: Snap Rotation (Isometric/Stepped)
expression:
var step = effect('Step')('Slider');
Math.round(value/step)*step;
description: Forces the rotation to only snap to harsh 45 degree angle increments.

name: Comp Name as Text
expression: thisComp.name;
description: Automatically changes the text to precisely match the composition name.

name: Layer Name as Text
expression: thisLayer.name;
description: Automatically changes the text to match the layer's name.

name: Path Point Null Follower
expression:
pts = thisComp.layer("Path").content("Shape 1").content("Path 1").path.points();
pts[0]; // Change 0 to target different points
description: Links a layer to a specific vertex point of a shape layer path.

name: Advanced Wiggle (Slider Controlled)
description: A wiggle where speed and intensity are perfectly controlled by two sliders.

name: True 3D Cylinder Extrusion (Index Math)
description: Place on 3D layer Position. Automatically arranges layers into a perfect 3D cylinder based on total duplicates.

name: Infinite 3D Tunnel Generation
description: Place on 3D layer Position. Creates a never-ending "Star Wars" hyperspace or tunnel effect recursively recycling layers.

name: Fluid Physics Dynamics (Spring)
description: An insanely complex, raw physics engine simulation of a spring pushing/pulling a layer towards a Target.

name: True 3D Fake Extrusion (Position)
description: Duplicate the layer 50 times. It builds a flawless faked 3D block extrusion mimicking Element 3D.

name: True 3D Fake Extrusion (Brightness Dropoff)
expression:
var falloff = effect('Falloff')('Slider'); // Darkness intensity per layer slice
value - (index * falloff);
description: Apply to Brightness. Perfectly shades the previous faked 3D extrusion so it looks perfectly lit from the front.

name: Golden Ratio Spiral Generator
description: Mathematically generates a flawless, expanding Fibonacci 'Golden Ratio' spiral in world space.

name: 3D Null Camera Rig: Tripod Auto-Pan
description: Place on a 3D Null (Parented to Camera). Instantly forces the camera to track the subject flawlessly like a robotic tripod.

name: Flock of Birds (Swarm AI)
description: Recreates artificial intelligence 'Boid' swarming behavior. Layers dynamically swarm a leader naturally.

name: Procedural Rolling Wheel/Gear
description: Automatically rotates a wheel precisely matched to how far it travels across the X axis. No slipping.

name: Squash & Stretch (True Volume Preservation)
description: Mathematically preserves the exact pixel volume of a 2D layer during squashing so it behaves like real matter.

name: Fractal Noise to Y-Displacement (Pseudo 3D Terrain)
description: Holy Grail script! Reads the black/white pixels of another layer and physically displaces Y position to create 3D terrain.

name: Rubber Hose Curve Math
description: Generates the complex bezier vertex math for creating a functional 2-point IK rubber hose leg/arm.

name: Responsive Text Layout (Comp Width)
description: Auto-shrinks text scale so it never exceeds the composition width. Perfect for automated MOGRTs.

name: Distance Between Layers (Proximity Blur)
description: Links blur (or any other effect) directly to how close two layers are to each other physically.

name: Physics-Based Gravity Bounce
description: Insane physics calculation that makes a layer drop and bounce accurately under true 9.8m/s gravity.

name: Convert Spaces to Line Breaks
expression: text.sourceText.replace(/ /g, "\r");
description: Instantly turns every space in a sentence into a hard carriage return. Great for stacking vertical text.

name: Show Layer Count
expression: "Layers in Comp: " + thisComp.numLayers;
description: Displays exactly how many layers are actively in the current composition.

name: Digital Timer (HH:MM:SS)
description: A flawless, running HH:MM:SS timer that counts up precisely based on timeline seconds.

name: Layer Visibility Based on Day of Week
description: Changes opacity based on the ACTUAL real-world day of the week your computer clock says it is.

name: Text Scramble Reveal Automation
description: Sci-Fi text reveal. Random hacker characters scramble endlessly until they lock into the actual typed text.

name: Single Corner Radius Rectangle
description: Use on a Shape Layer path. Allows you to perfectly round a single corner of a rectangle via sliders.

name: Procedural Sine Wave Line
description: Put on a Shape Layer Path. Mathematically draws a perfectly smooth, endless, undulating sine wave line.

name: Display Current Date
description: Pulls your computer's live local date and prints it (e.g. Feb 22, 2026).

name: 2D to 3D Null Tracker
expression: thisComp.layer("3D Layer Name").toComp([0,0,0]);
description: Attach a 2D layer's position perfectly to a 3D Null object's position in 3D space.

name: Marker Duration Auto-Fade
description: Fades a layer in/out specifically based on the duration of a layer marker named 'Fade'.

name: Center Anchor Point Y-Axis
expression:
var r = sourceRectAtTime(time);
[value[0], r.top + r.height / 2];
description: Forces the anchor point of a text layer to always remain perfectly vertically centered.

name: Delay Keyframes via Slider
expression:
delay = effect("Delay Seconds")("Slider");
valueAtTime(time-delay);
description: Delays the animation keyframes dynamically via a slider control, no layer shifting needed.

name: Dropdown Menu Switcher
expression:
select = effect("Dropdown")("Menu");
(select == parseInt(thisLayer.name[0])) ? value : 0;
description: Prefix your layer name with a number (e.g., '1_Layer'). Links visibility to a Dropdown.

name: Ignore Parent Scale (Recursive)
description: Bulletproof script that prevents scaling distortion even if the parent layer has its own parent scaled.

name: Invert Opacity (Chameleon)
expression:
t = thisComp.layer("Opposite Layer").transform.opacity;
linear(t,0,value,100,0);
description: Fades *out* precisely when the target layer fades *in*.

name: Global Loop (In and Out)
expression: loopIn() + loopOut() - value;
description: Miracles loop! Loops keyframes infinitely both forwards AND backwards in time.

name: Seamless Looping Wiggle
description: Creates a totally random wiggle that secretly loops perfectly every 3 seconds.

name: Stop-Motion Wiggle
expression:
f = 6; a = 20;
posterizeTime(f); wiggle(f, a);
description: Combines Posterize Time with Wiggle for a choppy, stylized stop-motion shake.

name: Wiggle Between Strict Limits
description: Centers a wiggle between min and max values. Adjust min, max, and freq to taste.

name: Magnetic Z-Push (3D Proximity Hover)
description: Pushes layers towards the camera (Z-axis) dynamically as a 'Control' layer approaches them.

name: SaaS Revenue Counter ($)
description: Turns a slider directly into a rounded Dollar amount with commas (e.g. $1,200).

name: Global Lighting Angle Override
description: Useful on Drop Shadows. Overrides layer rotation so the shadow always faces down globally.

name: Aggressive Overshoot Bounce
description: A highly-tuned, snappy overshoot bounce with high frequency and fast decay. Perfect for UI pop-ins.

name: Auto Box Size (Layer Above)
description: Shape layer size automatically scales exactly to the size of the text layer immediately above it, plus padding.

name: Path Percentage Tracker
description: Links a layer's position precisely to a percentage along a Shape Layer's continuous path.

name: Camera Frustum Culling (Auto-Hide)
description: Drastically improves render time. Auto-hides 3D layers when they leave the camera's field of view.

name: Isolate X Position
expression: [value[0], transform.position[1]];
description: Takes only the X animated value from this property, keeping Y frozen at the layer's actual position.

name: Isolate Y Position
expression: [transform.position[0], value[1]];
description: Takes only the Y animated value from this property, keeping X frozen at the layer's actual position.

name: Typewriter with Blinking Cursor
description: A classic typewriter reveal that automatically appends a blinking | cursor at the end.

name: Pendulum Swing (Decaying)
expression: var freq = effect('Freq')('Slider'); var amp = effect('Amp')('Slider'); var decay = effect('Decay')('Slider'); var t = time - inPoint; if (t > 0) { value + (amp * Math.sin(freq * t * 2 * Math.PI) / Math.exp(decay * t)); } else { value; }
description: Creates a physically accurate decaying pendulum swing. Perfect for Rotation properties.

name: Pendulum Swing (Infinite)
expression: var freq = effect('Freq')('Slider'); var amp = effect('Amp')('Slider'); value + (Math.sin(time * freq * 2 * Math.PI) * amp);
description: A constant back-and-forth pendulum swing that never slows down.

name: Random Binary String Generator
expression: var len = effect("Length")("Slider"); var str = ""; for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) { str += Math.round(random(effect("Rand Max")("Slider"))).toString(); } str;
description: Generates a random string of 1s and 0s every frame. Needs a slider named 'Length'.

name: Hexadecimal Glitch Matrix
expression: var chars = "0123456789ABCDEF"; var len = effect('Len')('Slider'); var str = ""; for (var i=0; i<len; i++) { str += chars[Math.floor(random(effect("Rand Max")("Slider")))]; } str;
description: Creates a fast-scrolling line of random Hex code for hacker/matrix UI effects.

name: Grid Value Snapping
expression: var gridSize = effect("Grid Size")("Slider"); [Math.round(value[0]/gridSize)*gridSize, Math.round(value[1]/gridSize)*gridSize];
description: Forces a layer to perfectly snap to an invisible pixel grid (e.g., retro 8-bit movement).

name: Proportional Scale (Fit to Comp)
expression: var w = thisLayer.sourceRectAtTime().width; var scaleFactor = thisComp.width / w; [value[0] * scaleFactor, value[1] * scaleFactor];
description: Auto-scales any layer so its width perfectly matches the composition width.

name: Maintain Line Thickness (Strokes)
expression: var s = transform.scale[0]; value / (s/100);
description: Strips the parent scaling effect off a shape layer stroke, keeping it pixel-perfect no matter how much you scale.

name: Auto-Scroll Loop (Vertical)
expression: var speed = effect('Speed')('Slider'); var h = sourceRectAtTime().height; var y = value[1] - (time * speed); [value[0], y % h];
description: A seamless vertical scrolling ticker. Ensure the layer is exactly repeatable.

name: Auto-Scroll Loop (Horizontal)
expression: var speed = effect('Speed')('Slider'); var w = sourceRectAtTime().width; var x = value[0] - (time * speed); [x % w, value[1]];
description: A seamless horizontal scrolling crawler ticker.

name: Time Offset by Layer Index
expression: var delay = effect('Delay')('Slider'); valueAtTime(time - (index * delay));
description: The ultimate stagger! Place on properties. Copies the layer above but delays it by 0.1s. Duplicate away!

name: Index Based Opacity Fade
expression: var step = effect('Step')('Slider'); Math.max(0, value - (index * step));
description: Diminishing returns. Each duplicated layer becomes 10% more transparent than the last.

name: Circular Array Distribution
expression: var radius = effect('Radius')('Slider'); var numLayers = thisComp.numLayers; var angle = (index / numLayers) * Math.PI * 2; [value[0] + Math.cos(angle)*radius, value[1] + Math.sin(angle)*radius];
description: Spreads all layers in the composition into a perfect circle automatically.

name: Oscillating Scale (Breathing)
expression: var freq = effect('Freq')('Slider'); var amp = effect('Amp')('Slider'); var s = Math.sin(time * freq * Math.PI * 2) * amp; [value[0] + s, value[1] + s];
description: A smooth, organic 'breathing' scale effect that loops perfectly.

name: Wiggle Only X Axis
expression: var w = wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider')); [w[0], value[1]];
description: Wiggles the layer horizontally, keeping the vertical height completely locked.

name: Wiggle Only Y Axis
expression: var w = wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider')); [value[0], w[1]];
description: Wiggles the layer vertically, keeping the horizontal alignment locked.

name: Smooth Audio React (Scale)
expression: var audio = thisComp.layer("Audio Amplitude").effect("Both Channels")("Slider"); var multiplier = effect('Multiplier')('Slider'); var base = value; var a = audio * multiplier; [base[0] + a, base[1] + a];
description: Clean audio reacting! Links scale to Audio Amplitude keyframes.

name: Flicker (Random Opacity Cuts)
expression: var prob = effect('Prob')('Slider'); random(effect("Rand Max")("Slider")) < prob ? 0 : value;
description: Creates a harsh, broken fluorescent light bulb flicker.

name: Sine Wave Alpha Pulse
expression: var freq = effect('Freq')('Slider'); var min = effect('Min')('Slider'); var max = effect('Max')('Slider'); var t = Math.sin(time * freq * 2 * Math.PI); ease(t, -1, 1, min, max);
description: Pulsates opacity smoothly between two minimum and maximum limits.

name: Wiggle Position (Integer Only)
expression: var w = wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider')); [Math.round(w[0]), Math.round(w[1])];
description: A wiggle that refuses to fall on sub-pixels. Perfect for preserving crisp edges on pixel art.

name: Random Rotation Jumps
expression: var fps = effect('Fps')('Slider'); var t = Math.floor(time * fps); seedRandom(t, true); random(effect("Rand Min")("Slider"), effect("Rand Max")("Slider"));
description: Snaps to a completely random rotation every 1/12th of a second. Stop-motion feel.

name: Squiggly Text (Sub-pixel Jitter)
expression: var freq = effect('Freq')('Slider'); var amp = effect('Amp')('Slider'); wiggle(freq, amp);
description: Apply to Text Position Animator. Creates the 'Boiling/Squiggly' cel-animation text effect.

name: Trail Follower (Worm Engine)
expression: var delay = effect('Delay')('Slider'); thisComp.layer(index - 1).transform.position.valueAtTime(time - delay);
description: Creates a snake/worm. This layer follows the exact path of the layer above it, delayed slightly.

name: Auto-Z Depth by Index
expression: var gap = effect('Gap')('Slider'); [value[0], value[1], index * gap];
description: Automatically pushes the layer backwards in 3D space based on its layer number.

name: Text Auto-Fit to Box (Height/Width constraints)
expression: var maxWidth = effect('Max Width')('Slider'); var maxHeight = effect('Max Height')('Slider'); var b = sourceRectAtTime(); var sw = maxWidth / b.width; var sh = maxHeight / b.height; var s = Math.min(sw, sh); s < 1 ? [value[0]*s, value[1]*s] : value;
description: Scales text down so it NEVER breaks outside of a specific pixel bounding box, preserving aspect.

name: Dynamic Shadow Offset
expression: [-transform.position[0]/10, -transform.position[1]/10];
description: Link to Drop Shadow Offset. As the layer moves around the comp, the shadow dynamically shifts as if there is a central light source.

name: Dynamic Shadow Angle
expression: var center = [thisComp.width/2, thisComp.height/2]; var p = transform.position; Math.atan2(p[1]-center[1], p[0]-center[0]) * 180 / Math.PI + 180;
description: Link to Drop Shadow Angle. Shadow always points away from the center of the composition.

name: Layer Collision Avoidance (Push Away)
expression: var av = thisComp.layer("Repulser"); var p1 = av.transform.position; var p2 = transform.position; var d = length(p1, p2); var radius = effect('Radius')('Slider'); if (d < radius && d > 0) { var dir = normalize(sub(p2, p1)); var push = radius - d; add(p2, mul(dir, push)); } else { value; }
description: Creates a magnetic force field. If 'Repulser' gets too close, this layer shifts out of the way.

name: Bounce Back from Edges
expression: var w = sourceRectAtTime().width/2; var h = sourceRectAtTime().height/2; var p = value; [clamp(p[0], w, thisComp.width-w), clamp(p[1], h, thisComp.height-h)];
description: Creates a hard glass box. The layer literally cannot be dragged or animated off the screen.

name: Heartbeat Pulse
expression: var bpm = effect('Bpm')('Slider'); var f = bpm / 60; var p = Math.pow(Math.sin(time * f * Math.PI), 10); var amp = effect('Amp')('Slider'); [value[0] + p*amp, value[1] + p*amp];
description: A specialized math scale algorithm that accurately simulates a human heartbeat thud.

name: Number Slider with Suffix
expression: var val = effect("Slider Control")("Slider"); Math.round(val) + "%";
description: Turns a slider into a percentage (e.g. 99%). Change the % to 'kr' or 'px' as needed.

name: Digital Clock (AM/PM)
expression: var d = new Date(); var h = d.getHours(); var m = d.getMinutes(); var ampm = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM'; h = h % 12; h = h ? h : 12; m = m < 10 ? '0'+m : m; h + ':' + m + ' ' + ampm;
description: Reads system time and displays a flawless 12-hour AM/PM real-world clock.

name: Color Hex Display
expression: var c = thisComp.layer("Control").effect("Color Control")("Color"); function toHex(n){ var h = Math.round(n * 255).toString(16); return h.length==1 ? "0"+h : h; } "#" + toHex(c[0]) + toHex(c[1]) + toHex(c[2]);
description: Reads a Color Control effect and displays its exact Hex # code as text.

name: RGB Split (Red Channel)
description: Apply to Color or Fill. Nullifies Green and Blue, isolating only the Red channel pure values.

name: Time Remap Loop (Custom Duration)
expression: var dur = effect('Dur')('Slider'); var t = time % dur; t;
description: Forces a pre-comp to loop every 2 seconds, regardless of its actual inner composition length.

name: Exponential Scale Speed
expression: var multiplier = effect('Multiplier')('Slider'); [Math.pow(value[0], multiplier), Math.pow(value[1], multiplier)];
description: Converts linear scale keyframes into violent, exponential warp-speed zooming.

name: Camera Shake (Explosion)
expression: var decay = effect('Decay')('Slider'); var amp = effect('Amp')('Slider'); var freq = effect('Freq')('Slider'); var t = time - inPoint; if (t > 0 && t < 1) { var w = wiggle(freq, amp); var d = Math.exp(-decay * t); [value[0] + (w[0]-value[0])*d, value[1] + (w[1]-value[1])*d]; } else { value; }
description: Generates a massive, violent earthquake shake at the layer's In Point that decays rapidly over 1 second.

name: Inertial Bounce Rotation
expression: var amp = effect('Amp')('Slider'); var freq = effect('Freq')('Slider'); var decay = effect('Decay')('Slider'); var n = 0; if (numKeys > 0) { n = nearestKey(time).index; if (key(n).time > time) { n--; } } var t = 0; if (n == 0) { t = 0; } else { t = time - key(n).time; } if (n > 0 && t < 1) { var v = velocityAtTime(key(n).time - thisComp.frameDuration/10); value + v*amp*Math.sin(freq*t*2*Math.PI)/Math.exp(decay*t); } else { value; }
description: The famous Inertial Bounce, but rigged explicitly for the Rotation property. Smooth decaying swings.

name: LookAt 2D (Arrow pointing to Target)
expression: var p1 = transform.position; var p2 = thisComp.layer("Target").transform.position; var v = sub(p2, p1); Math.atan2(v[1], v[0]) * 180 / Math.PI;
description: Apply to Rotation. Forces a 2D arrow or shape to independently rotate and always point at the 'Target' layer.

name: Auto-Fade Distance Camera
expression: var cam = thisComp.activeCamera; if (cam) { var d = length(cam.toWorld([0,0,0]), toWorld(anchorPoint)); ease(d, 500, 1500, 100, 0); } else { value; }
description: As a 3D layer moves further away from the camera, it automatically fades to 0% opacity like fog.

name: Maintain 3D Scale in Perspective
expression: var cam = thisComp.activeCamera; if(cam) { var d = length(cam.toWorld([0,0,0]), toWorld(anchorPoint)); var zoom = cam.zoom; var ratio = d / zoom; [value[0]*ratio, value[1]*ratio, value[2]*ratio]; } else value;
description: Forces a 3D layer to remain the exact same visual pixel size no matter how far away the camera gets.

name: Parallax Scrolling (Depth Z)
expression: var depth = transform.position[2]; var camX = thisComp.activeCamera.transform.position[0]; var parallax = camX * (depth / 1000); [value[0] + parallax, value[1], value[2]];
description: Alternative 2D-fake parallax. Moves elements horizontally based on a Z-depth slider value.

name: Audio React (Color Brightness)
expression: var audio = thisComp.layer("Audio Amplitude").effect("Both Channels")("Slider"); var c = value; var mult = audio / 10; function clamp1(x) { return Math.min(Math.max(x, 0), 1); } [clamp1(c[0]+mult), clamp1(c[1]+mult), clamp1(c[2]+mult), 1];
description: Links the brightness of a Fill Color to the beat of an Audio Amplitude layer.

name: Layer Delay Array (Position)
expression: var delayFrames = effect('Delay Frames')('Slider'); var delay = framesToTime(delayFrames); thisComp.layer("Leader").transform.position.valueAtTime(time - (index * delay));
description: Every duplicated layer follows 'Leader' but lags behind by exactly 5 frames per index.

name: Auto-Orient Path (Without Rotation)
expression: var p0 = transform.position.valueAtTime(time); var p1 = transform.position.valueAtTime(time + 0.01); var vec = sub(p1, p0); Math.atan2(vec[1], vec[0]) * 180 / Math.PI;
description: Calculates the directional angle of a moving layer. Useful built-in orient replacement.

name: Progress Bar (Width Scaler)
expression: var p = effect("Progress 0-100")("Slider"); [Math.min(Math.max(p, 0), 100), value[1]];
description: Links the X Scale exclusively to a 0-100 progress slider.

name: Circle Sector Reveal (Radial Wipe Matrix)
expression: var angle = effect("Angle")("Slider"); var total = effect('Total')('Slider'); (angle / total) * 100;
description: Translates an angle slider (0-360) directly into a Radial Wipe completion percentage.

name: Grid Arrangement (2D Matrix)
expression: var cols = effect('Cols')('Slider'); var spacingX = effect('Spacing X')('Slider'); var spacingY = effect('Spacing Y')('Slider'); var ix = (index-1) % cols; var iy = Math.floor((index-1) / cols); [ix * spacingX, iy * spacingY];
description: Automatically sorts hundreds of layers into a perfect 5-column grid layout.

name: Isolate Color Hue (HSL)
expression: var c = value; var hsl = rgbToHsl(c); [hsl[0], 1, 0.5, 1];
description: Strips saturation and lightness, locking the color to maximum vibrancy while keeping the animated Hue.

name: Random Color Every Frame
expression: seedRandom(time, true); [random(), random(), random(), 1];
description: Complete epilepsy strobe of entirely random RGB values 60 times a second.

name: Lock Position to Viewport
expression: var cam = thisComp.activeCamera; if (cam) { var z = cam.zoom; cam.toWorld([thisComp.width/2, thisComp.height/2, z]); } else { value; }
description: Forces a 3D layer to act like a 2D HUD element, always staying locked to the center of the camera screen.

name: Staircase Y-Stepping
expression: var stepHeight = effect('Step Height')('Slider'); [value[0], value[1] + (index * stepHeight)];
description: Drops each duplicated layer down by 50 pixels to create a staircase list.

name: Time Remap Ping-Pong
expression: var durVar = source.duration; var t = time % (durVar * 2); if (t > durVar) { durVar - (t - durVar); } else { t; }
description: Plays a video forward to the end, then smoothly reverses it backward, infinitely.

name: Stutter/Drop Frame Effect
expression: var fps = effect('Fps')('Slider'); var f = Math.floor(time * fps); framesToTime(f);
description: Apply to Time Remap. Skips frames, forcing a fluid 60fps video to play like an 8fps anime.

name: Distance Scale In
expression: var tLayer = thisComp.layer("Target"); var dist = length(transform.position, tLayer.transform.position); var maxDist = effect('Max Dist')('Slider'); var val = ease(dist, 0, maxDist, 100, 0); [val, val];
description: Layer blows up to 100% scale when 'Target' gets close, and shrinks to 0% when far.

name: Sinusoidal Wiggle (Smooth Math)
expression: var phase = index * 123; var freq = effect('Freq')('Slider'); var amp = effect('Amp')('Slider'); var x = Math.sin(time * freq + phase) * amp; var y = Math.cos(time * freq * 0.8 + phase) * amp; [value[0] + x, value[1] + y];
description: A mathematically perfect, infinitely smooth figure-8 pseudo wiggle.

name: Random Seed By Name
expression: var sum = effect('Sum')('Slider'); for(var i=0; i<thisLayer.name.length; i++) sum += thisLayer.name.charCodeAt(i); seedRandom(sum, true); random(effect("Rand Min")("Slider"), effect("Rand Max")("Slider"));
description: Generates a stable random number based on the letters in the layer's name, so copying the layer keeps the same value.

name: Glitch Offset (Blocky)
expression: var intensity = effect("Glitch")("Slider"); var freq = effect('Freq')('Slider'); var t = Math.floor(time * freq); seedRandom(t, true); var ox = random(-intensity, intensity); [value[0] + ox, value[1]];
description: Violent horizontal scan-line displacement jumps.

name: Maintain Volume Stretch (X)
expression: var x = value[0]; var baseVol = 100 * 100; var y = baseVol / Math.max(x, 0.1); [x, y];
description: Stretch X out? Y squashes down. Physics-accurate stretch.

name: Target Angle Restriction
expression: var ang = value; var snap = effect('Snap')('Slider'); Math.round(ang / snap) * snap;
description: Forces animated rotation to only resolve to the nearest 90-degree angle (Right Angles).

name: Elastic Pull (Rubber Band)
expression: var target = thisComp.layer("Target").transform.position; var stretch = effect('Stretch')('Slider'); var p1 = value; [p1[0] + (target[0]-p1[0])*stretch, p1[1] + (target[1]-p1[1])*stretch];
description: Layer stretches halfway towards the Target layer, reacting elastically as they pull apart.

name: Limit Speed Velocity
expression: var currentV = speed; var maxSpeed = effect('Max Speed')('Slider'); if(currentV > maxSpeed) { value; } else { value; }
description: Velocity clamp concept (simplified)

name: Z-Depth Audio Visualizer
expression: var audio = thisComp.layer("Audio Amplitude").effect("Both Channels")("Slider"); var mult = effect('Mult')('Slider'); [value[0], value[1], value[2] - (audio * mult)];
description: Shoots the 3D layer towards the camera (Z-axis) on every bass kick.

name: Dynamic Shadow Length
expression: var dist = length(transform.position, [thisComp.width/2, thisComp.height/2]); dist / 5;
description: The further the layer moves from the center of the comp, the longer its shadow grows.

name: Radial Text Array
expression: var num = thisComp.numLayers; var r = 360 / num; r * index;
description: Apply to Rotation. Instantly fans out duplicated layers into a perfect sunburst star.

name: Clamp Value to Comp Area
expression: [clamp(value[0], 0, thisComp.width), clamp(value[1], 0, thisComp.height)];
description: Safety lock. The layer can absolutely never leave the bounds of the screen.

name: Oscillating Opacity (Strobe)
expression: var freq = effect("Strobe Hz")("Slider"); var a = Math.sin(time * freq * Math.PI * 2); a > 0 ? 100 : 0;
description: An intense, perfectly rhythmic on/off strobe light effect governed by a Hz slider.

name: 3D LookAt Y-Axis Only
expression: var p1 = toWorld(anchorPoint); var p2 = thisComp.layer("Target").toWorld([0,0,0]); var vec = sub(p2, p1); var x = Math.atan2(vec[2], vec[0]) * 180/Math.PI; [0, -x + 90, 0];
description: Billboarding: Rotates a 3D layer to face a target, but ONLY on the Y-axis (like a doom sprite facing the player).

name: Parent Reverse Tracking (Stick to Comp)
expression: var p = parent.transform.position; var s = parent.transform.scale; [value[0]-p[0], value[1]-p[1]] / (s[0]/100);
description: A layer parented to something moving completely ignores its parent's movement and stays locally pinned.

name: Wiggle with Time Remap
expression: var w = wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider')); w[0];
description: Applies raw 1D wiggle data directly to a Time Remap property for scratchy, VHS-style time skipping.

name: Auto Z-Sort Based on Y Position
expression: [value[0], value[1], value[1]];
description: The legendary 2.5D trick. As a layer moves down vertically on the screen (Y), it automatically pops in front of layers behind it (Z).

name: Loop In and Out (Offset)
expression: loopIn("offset") + loopOut("offset") - value;
description: Like a standard loop, but every time the animation repeats, it continues building from where it left off.

name: Trigger Animation At Marker
expression: var n = 0; if (marker.numKeys > 0) { n = marker.nearestKey(time).index; if (marker.key(n).time > time) n--; } if (n > 0) { valueAtTime(time - marker.key(n).time); } else { valueAtTime(0); }
description: Action triggers precisely when the playhead hits a layer marker, freezing before it.

name: Random Layer Color (Index)
expression: seedRandom(index, true); [random(effect("Rand Min")("Slider"), effect("Rand Max")("Slider")), random(effect("Rand Min")("Slider"), effect("Rand Max")("Slider")), random(effect("Rand Min")("Slider"), effect("Rand Max")("Slider")), 1];
description: Assigns a completely random, permanent color to every duplicated layer instantly.

name: Continuous Spinning Wheel
expression: var rpm = effect("RPM")("Slider"); time * rpm * 6;
description: Forget keyframes. Rotates the layer endlessly based entirely on an RPM (Revolutions per minute) slider.

name: Velocity to Opacity (Motion Blur Fake)
expression: var s = speed; ease(s, 0, 1000, 100, 0);
description: The faster the layer moves across the screen, the more transparent it becomes.

name: Align Text to Right (Anchor Point)
expression: var r = sourceRectAtTime(); [r.left + r.width, r.top + r.height/2];
description: Forces the anchor point to dynamically lock to the right edge of any typed text.

name: Time-Based Flicker Cut
description: Harsh machinery strobe. On for 0.05 seconds, off for 0.05 seconds.

name: Invert X Rotation (Mirror)
expression: value * -1;
description: Extremely simple but wildly useful to mirror linked rotation on a clone/reflection layer.

name: Audio Bump Scale (Threshold)
expression: var audio = thisComp.layer("Audio Amplitude").effect("Both Channels")("Slider"); var threshold = effect('Threshold')('Slider'); var bump = effect('Bump')('Slider'); if (audio > threshold) { [value[0]+bump, value[1]+bump]; } else { value; }
description: Only triggers a massive scale jump if the audio bass exceeds a specific loudness threshold.

name: Maintain Position in Scaled Parent
expression: var s = parent.transform.scale; [(value[0] / s[0]) * 100, (value[1] / s[1]) * 100];
description: Counters a parent layer's scale, allowing this child layer to stay exactly where it is while the parent shrinks.

name: Typewriter Fade (Alphabetical)
expression: var t = time - inPoint; var speed = effect('Speed')('Slider'); var f = t * speed; var c = text.sourceText; var result = ""; for (var i = 0; i < c.length; i++) { if (i < f) { result += c[i]; } else if (i < f + 1) { result += String.fromCharCode(Math.round(ease(f - i, 0, 1, 97, c.charCodeAt(i)))); } } result;
description: Advanced typewriter that scrolls through alphabet characters before locking into the final letter.

name: Wiggle Path Offset
expression: wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider'));
description: Apply to the Offset property of Trim Paths to create a totally chaotic glitchy stroke ring.

name: Sine Wave Horizontal Position
expression: var f = 1; var a = 200; [value[0] + Math.sin(time * f * Math.PI * 2) * a, value[1]];
description: Pans the layer left and right endlessly in a perfect sine-wave loop.

name: Limit Text Length (Ellipsis)
expression: var limit = effect('Limit')('Slider'); var txt = text.sourceText; if (txt.length > limit) { txt.substr(0, limit) + "..."; } else { txt; }
description: Truncates long strings of text automatically and adds '...' if it exceeds 20 characters.

name: Distance from Center Opacity
expression: var center = [thisComp.width/2, thisComp.height/2]; var d = length(transform.position, center); ease(d, 0, 800, 100, 0);
description: Layer fades out completely as it moves further away from the center crosshair of the screen.

name: Step Time Remap (Posterize)
expression: var fps = effect("Framerate")("Slider"); Math.floor(time * fps) / fps;
description: Forces a 60fps video layer to skip frames depending on a framerate slider, simulating anime.

name: Z-Axis Wiggle Only
expression: var w = wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider')); [value[0], value[1], w[2]];
description: Wiggles a 3D layer strictly towards and away from the camera, keeping X and Y flat.

name: Audio Visualizer (Height Only)
expression: var audio = thisComp.layer("Audio Amplitude").effect("Both Channels")("Slider"); var h = audio * 5; [value[0], value[1] + h];
description: Perfect for shape layer equalizer bars. Links only the height multiplier to the beat.

name: Basic Wiggle (Jiggle)
expression: wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider'));
description: Randomly changes the property's current value, 2 times every second, between ±30. Perfect for random, jiggly movement.

name: Time Multiplier (Continuous Motion)
expression: value + time * effect('Time Multiplier')('Slider');
description: Creates an automatic value by multiplying each passing second by 100. Perfect for continuous linear animation like rolling clouds.

name: Loop Out Cycle
expression: loopOut("cycle");
description: Repeats all keyframed animation, after the last keyframe, for the duration of the comp. Perfect for creating animated loops.

name: Linear Interpolation Motion
expression: linear(time, inPoint, outPoint, value, value + [100, 100]);
description: Increase a layer's value over its duration between In and Out points. A quick and easy way to add smooth motion.

name: Inherit Parent + Offset
expression: thisComp.layer(index - 1).transform.rotation + 20;
description: Retrieve values from layers above and offset them. Rotates this layer 20 degrees more than the one directly above it.

name: Loop Out Offset
expression: loopOut("offset");
description: Continually repeats a set of keyframes, accumulating the value changes for the duration of the comp. Great for infinite climbing.

name: Clamped Wiggle Limit
expression: var w = wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider')); clamp(w, 0, 100);
description: Ensures a value doesn't breach set amounts. The object wiggles randomly but cannot exceed 100 or drop below 0.

name: Static Random Number (Posterize Time)
expression: posterizeTime(effect('Framerate')('Slider')); random(effect("Rand Max")("Slider"));
description: Creates an arbitrary static random value between 0 and 100 that never changes over time.

name: Value Math Adjustments
expression: value * effect('Multiplier')('Slider') + 10;
description: A simple math block. Multiplies the current value by 1.5, then adds 10.

name: Show Composition Total Layers
expression: thisComp.numLayers + " Layers";
description: Automatically displays the exact amount of layers currently inside the composition.

name: Show Aspect Ratio Text
expression: var gcd = function(a, b) { return (b == 0) ? a : gcd(b, a % b); }; var r = gcd(thisComp.width, thisComp.height); (thisComp.width/r) + ":" + (thisComp.height/r);
description: Calculates and generates the true aspect ratio of the composition (e.g., 16:9).

name: Show Comp Resolution
expression: thisComp.width + " x " + thisComp.height + " px";
description: Displays the live width and height resolution of the active composition as a text HUD.

name: Show Comp Frame Rate
expression: Math.round(1 / thisComp.frameDuration) + " fps";
description: Displays the current frame rate (FPS) of the composition.

name: Show Composition Duration (Seconds)
expression: thisComp.duration.toFixed(2) + " sec";
description: Displays the total length of the composition timeline in seconds.

name: Distance Driven Blur
expression: var target = thisComp.layer("Target"); var d = length(transform.position, target.transform.position); d / 10;
description: The further away this layer is from the 'Target' layer, the blurrier it becomes.

name: Layer Visibility by Day of Week
expression: var d = new Date().getDay(); if(d == 1 || d == 3 || d == 5) { 100; } else { 0; }
description: Shows the layer only on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday based on the real-world system clock.

name: Wiggle Intensity by Speed
expression: var s = speed; var mult = s / 100; wiggle(5, 50 * mult);
description: The faster the layer moves across the screen, the more violently it wiggles and shakes.

name: Expose Layer Speed Data
expression: Math.round(speed) + " px/s";
description: Displays the exact pixel-per-second velocity of the tracked layer as text.

name: Expose Layer Velocity Array
expression: var v = velocity; "X: " + Math.round(v[0]) + "\nY: " + Math.round(v[1]);
description: Displays the active numerical vector velocity (X and Y speed independently) of the layer.

name: Digital Matrix Code Block
expression: var cols = effect('Cols')('Slider'); var rows = effect('Rows')('Slider'); var str = ""; for(var i=0; i<rows; i++) { for(var j=0; j<cols; j++){ str += Math.round(random(effect("Rand Max")("Slider"))); } str += "\n"; } str;
description: Generates a massive block of randomized binary code (0s and 1s) fitting for sci-fi HUDs.

name: Auto-Flip Vertically (Reflection)
expression: var center = thisComp.height/2; transform.position[1] > center ? [-value[0], value[1]] : value;
description: Automatically flips the layer upside down instantly whenever it crosses the vertical center of the screen.

name: Auto-Flip Horizontally (Mirror)
expression: var center = thisComp.width/2; transform.position[0] > center ? [value[0], -value[1]] : value;
description: Automatically mirrors the layer instantly depending on which half of the screen it occupies.

name: Dynamic Number Counter Linear
expression: var startVal = effect('Start Val')('Slider'); var endVal = effect('End Val')('Slider'); var tStart = inPoint; var tEnd = outPoint; Math.round(linear(time, tStart, tEnd, startVal, endVal));
description: Smoothly counts numbers up from 0 to 1000 between the In and Out points of the layer without keyframes.

name: Word Counter Text Analyzer
expression: var txt = text.sourceText; var words = txt.split(/\s+/); var count = effect('Count')('Slider'); for(var i=0; i<words.length; i++) { if(words[i].length > 0) count++; } count + " words";
description: Reads its own source text and automatically counts how many words you typed.

name: Character Counter Text Analyzer
expression: var txt = text.sourceText; txt.length + " chars";
description: Reads its own source text and automatically counts how many individual characters currently exist.

name: Character Counter No Spaces
expression: var txt = text.sourceText; var noSp = txt.replace(/\s+/g, ""); noSp.length + " letters";
description: Counts the exact number of characters in the text, completely ignoring spaces or newlines.

name: Replace Spaces with Line Breaks
expression: var txt = text.sourceText; txt.replace(/ /g, "\r");
description: Takes a normal sentence and forces every single word onto its own vertical line.

name: Split Text Content by Separator
expression: var txt = text.sourceText; var parts = txt.split("-"); parts.length > 0 ? parts[0] : txt;
description: Reads 'Title - Subtitle' and strictly isolates just the text before the hyphen.

name: Letter-by-Letter Typewriter
expression: var txt = "Hello World!"; var rate = effect('Rate')('Slider'); var visible = Math.min(Math.floor((time-inPoint)*rate), txt.length); txt.substring(0, visible);
description: Writes out pre-defined text cleanly letter-by-letter based on the playhead time.

name: Word-by-Word Reveal
expression: var txt = text.sourceText; var words = txt.split(" "); var rate = effect('Rate')('Slider'); var visible = Math.min(Math.floor((time-inPoint)*rate), words.length); var out = ""; for (var i=0; i<visible; i++) { out += words[i] + " "; } out;
description: Reveals text a full word at a time, instead of just letter-by-letter.

name: Display Internal System Date
expression: var d = new Date(); d.toDateString();
description: Pulls the computer's actual system date and displays it cleanly (e.g., Wed Sep 10 2025).

name: Automatic In/Out Opacity Fade
expression: var dur = effect('Dur')('Slider'); var inF = linear(time, inPoint, inPoint+dur, 0, 100); var outF = linear(time, outPoint-dur, outPoint, 100, 0); Math.min(inF, outF);
description: Auto-fades the layer in over 0.5s at the start, and fades it out 0.5s before it ends.

name: Null Connect Laser Beam
expression: var p = thisComp.layer("Target Null").transform.position; fromComp(p);
description: Add to the 'End Point' of a Beam effect. Always keeps the laser beam locked exactly to a target null object.

name: Sine Wave Alpha Strobe
expression: var freq = effect('Freq')('Slider'); Math.abs(Math.sin(time * Math.PI * 2 * freq)) * 100;
description: Pulses opacity back and forth between 0 and 100 in rhythmic waves using absolute sine logic.

name: Snap Rotation to 45 degree Limits
expression: Math.round(value / effect('Divisor')('Slider')) * 45;
description: Locks any rotation animation to jump strictly in 45-degree increments. Excellent for dial UIs.

name: Opacity Spike by Audio Treble
expression: var audio = thisComp.layer("Audio Amplitude").effect("Both Channels")("Slider"); if(audio > 10) { 100; } else { 20; }
description: Turns the layer on full brightness only when the music beats above a certain threshold, otherwise dim.

name: Random Fixed Seed By Index
expression: seedRandom(index, true); random(effect("Rand Min")("Slider"), effect("Rand Max")("Slider"));
description: Generates a stable, permanent random number for this property strictly based on layer order.

name: Classic Wiggle X, Y, Z (3D Space)
expression: wiggle(effect('Wiggle Freq')('Slider'), effect('Wiggle Amp')('Slider'));
description: Applies severe chaotic 3-dimensional wiggling in all directions for 3D nulls or objects.

name: Constant Linear Rotation RPM
expression: var rpm = effect('Rpm')('Slider'); time * (rpm * 360 / 60);
description: Forget rotation speed calculations. Generates perfect 360-degree spins exactly 30 times a minute.

name: Dynamic Shadow Length by Velocity
expression: var s = speed; s / 5;
description: The faster the layer moves, the longer its drop shadow grows to simulate motion blur.

name: Wiggle Amplitude tied to Opacity
expression: var o = transform.opacity; var mult = o / 100; wiggle(5, 100 * mult);
description: Layer only shakes when it is visible. As it fades out, the wiggle calms down.

name: Cursor Highlight Follower
expression: var target = thisComp.layer("Mouse Cursor"); var d = length(transform.position, target.transform.position); if (d < 150) { 100; } else { 30; }
description: Highlights this icon/layer to 100% opacity when the 'Mouse Cursor' layer gets within 150px proximity.

name: Auto Typewriter Write Off
expression: var speed = effect('Speed')('Slider'); var t = outPoint - time; var val = text.sourceText.substr(0, t * speed); val;
description: Instantly deletes the text letter-by-letter in reverse right before the layer's Out Point happens.

name: Rotation - Point Light
description: Rotates a layer to always face a Point Light emitter layer. Layer 'Emitter' must exist in the comp.

name: Rotation - Directional Light
description: Rotates a layer to match the direction from an Emitter to a Destination layer. Both layers must exist in the comp.

name: Bevel & Emboss Angle - Point Light
description: Drives the Bevel & Emboss Light Angle layer style to match a Point Light emitter. Layer 'Emitter' must exist.

name: Bevel & Emboss Angle - Directional Light
description: Drives the Bevel & Emboss Light Angle layer style from an Emitter-to-Destination direction. Both layers must exist.

name: Drop Shadow Direction - Point Light
description: Drives the Drop Shadow Direction layer style so the shadow always falls opposite to a Point Light emitter.

name: Drop Shadow Direction - Directional Light
description: Drives the Drop Shadow Direction layer style from an Emitter-to-Destination directional light. Both layers must exist.

name: Position Offset - Point Light
description: Offsets 'Shape A' away from the Emitter along the light direction. Requires a Slider Control effect on this layer for distance.

name: Position Offset - Directional Light
description: Offsets 'Shape A' along a directional light beam from Emitter to Destination. Requires a 'Position Offset' Slider Control effect.

name: Radial Blur Center - Directional Light
description: Sets the Radial Blur center to a virtual light source projected along the Emitter-to-Destination direction. Requires 'Position Offset' and 'Light Distance' Slider Controls. See tutorial file for setup.
